title: Storm Sorceress Over City
description: A female sorceress with flowing purple hair floats dynamically in the center of a massive swirling vortex of purple and blue clouds. She holds a glowing staff crackling with yellow lightning while casting a swirling blue energy spell, above a stormy coastal city with ships, wind turbines, and illuminated buildings under heavy rain and lightning.
prompt: A powerful sorceress with long flowing purple hair floats mid-air in the center of a massive swirling vortex of purple and blue clouds during a thunderstorm. She wears intricate brown leather and metal armor with blue glowing accents, holds a tall ornate staff crackling with yellow lightning in one hand, and casts a swirling blue energy spell with the other. Below her is a futuristic coastal city at dusk with illuminated buildings, wind turbines, docks, and old sailing ships on turbulent stormy seas with heavy rain and lightning strikes.
